links.outcome: Reading level of unprompted ChatGPT responses to hamstring injury FAQs (FRES, FKGL)
links.effect: Unprompted FRES 61.64 and FKGL 10.28 (about tenth-grade level); prompting for seventh-grade level gave FRES 75.2 and FKGL 6.1.
links.quote: On initial, unprompted queries, the readability of responses aligned with a tenth-grade level.

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT patient education responses unprompted versus prompted for plain language
links.effect: Unprompted FKGL 10.28 (above typical patient level); seventh-grade prompt lowered FKGL to 6.1 and raised FRES to 75.2; college prompt gave FKGL 17.23.
links.quote: However, when explicitly prompted, ChatGPT reliably adjusted the complexity of its responses to both a seventh-grade and a graduate-level reading standard.

unlisted_practices: Prompting a generative LLM to tailor response reading level to a specified grade level

screen.reason: The study tests whether explicit prompt instructions to tailor reading level (e.g., to a 7th-grade reading level) successfully modify the readability and complexity of LLM-generated patient education responses compared to unprompted baseline responses.
